source_title: Italy–Latvia convention 1997 (likumi.lv id 354) and 2004 exchange of notes (likumi.lv id 356), official Latvian texts

rates.quote: a) 5 procentus no dividenžu kopapjoma, ja dividenžu īstenais īpašnieks ir sabiedrība, kas nav līgumsabiedrība, un kas tieši pārvalda vismaz 10 procentus no kapitāla sabiedrībā, kura izmaksā dividendes;
b) 15 procentus no dividenžu kopapjoma visos pārējos gadījumos.

2. Tomēr šos procentus var arī aplikt ar nodokļiem atbilstoši attiecīgās valsts likumdošanas aktiem tajā Līgumslēdzējā Valstī, kurā tie rodas; ja procentu saņēmējs ir šo procentu īstenais īpašnieks, nodoklis nedrīkst pārsniegt 10 procentus no šo procentu kopapjoma.
b) 10 procentus no autoratlīdzības kopapjoma visos pārējos gadījumos.
a) 5 procentus no autoratlīdzības kopapjoma par ražošanas, tirdzniecības vai zinātnisko iekārtu izmantošanu;

notes: Art. 32(2)(a): WHT provisions apply to amounts paid on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2008-06-16) -> 2009-01-01. The 2004 exchange of notes (likumi.lv id 356; entered into force with the Convention) only concerns the Italian business property tax (Art. 2) - no effect on rates. 5% dividend tier: company (other than a partnership) directly holding at least 10% of capital. Royalty 5% tier: royalties for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment only (not a holding tier). Art. 11(3): government/central bank/government-guaranteed interest exempt - not modelled. Treaty refund article (tax withheld in excess refunded on claim) applies. Protocol para. on Art. 12: royalty MFN clause (later Latvian treaty with an OECD-member third State) (see MFN note below). Italy is not an MLI party, so no MLI PPT; the treaty has no general PPT. MFN: Protocol para. (j) - Latvia's later convention with Japan (an OECD member; signed 2017-01-18, in force 2017-07-05, WHT effective 2018-01-01; likumi.lv id 1727) provides exclusive residence taxation of royalties (Art. 12(1)), which by the clause applies automatically; royalty exemption recorded from 2018-01-01 (clause has no start date; 2018-01-01 used, matching Finland's notice SopS 15/2021 for the identical LV-FI clause). The earlier royalty entries describe the treaty text before the MFN took effect. [curated: dropped ROYALTY tier — MFN 0% (Latvia–Japan) not confirmed by an official notice]
unverified: MFN application: no partner-side official notice confirming the MFN exemption was located (Finland published one for the identical LV-FI clause); start date 2018-01-01 is an interpretation
